jobs.description:
Our client, located in the Beveren region, is looking for a Supervisor Piping & Mechanical with strong technical expertise and people leadership skills.
 
 

• You’ll lead, coordinate and supervise daily piping and mechanical maintenance activities with a strong focus on HSE, quality, cost control and operational continuity 

• You’ll plan, prioritize and allocate maintenance work to ensure efficient execution of both preventive and corrective maintenance activities 

• You’ll organize daily toolbox meetings, communicate priorities and ensure compliance with all safety procedures and permit-to-work requirements 

• You’ll actively supervise field activities and provide technical support to technicians and contractors during the execution of maintenance work 

• You’ll coordinate closely with Operations, Engineering, Reliability and Inspection departments to align maintenance priorities and ensure efficient plant availability 

• You’ll ensure the safe and efficient execution of maintenance activities on piping systems, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You’ll safeguard the mechanical integrity of plant assets by ensuring that maintenance and repair activities are executed according to engineering standards, site procedures and applicable regulations 

• You’ll support inspection programs and follow up on findings, integrity assessments, statutory inspections and corrective actions 

• You’ll coordinate and manage external contractors, ensuring compliance with safety, quality, planning and budget requirements 

• You’ll monitor work quality and verify that repairs, modifications and installations are completed according to specifications and industry standards 

• You’ll support the preparation, execution and evaluation of shutdowns, turnarounds and maintenance projects 

• You’ll drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, safety, efficiency and maintenance performance 

• You’ll ensure accurate maintenance administration and reporting in SAP, including work order completion, time registration and maintenance history 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical qualification, or equivalent by experience 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant maintenance experience within the petrochemical, chemical, oil & gas or related process industry 

• You’re experienced in a supervisory, team leader or coordination role within an industrial environment 

• You have solid knowledge of piping systems, pressure equipment, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You have a good understanding of mechanical integrity principles, inspection methodologies and reliability-driven maintenance practices 

• You have a strong knowledge of HSE requirements, permit-to-work systems, contractor management and process safety 

• You’re experienced with SAP or another CMMS system and good proficiency in Microsoft Office applications 

• You own strong planning, organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively manage changing priorities 

• You have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling effective collaboration across multiple disciplines 

• You are fluent in Dutch and have a good command of English 

• You have a hands-on leadership style with the ability to motivate, coach and develop people

Toyota is one of the world’s largest automobile manufacturers and a leading global corporation. Founded in 1937. Toyota now sells vehicles in 170 countries and employs over 350.000 people. Based in Brussels, Belgium, and staffed by 2.700 people and more than 60 nationalities, Toyota Motor Europe (TME) handles the wholesale marketing of Toyota and Lexus vehicles, parts & accessories, and manages Toyota’s European R&D, manufacturing, and engineering operations.

The company is excited to be transforming into a mobility company focusing on bringing even more happiness to our customers through various mobility solutions.

Jobomschrijving

Marketing Campaign Support

• Support the end-to-end planning and execution of integrated marketing campaigns for vehicle launches model year updates, special editions, and brand-building initiatives.
• Assist in developing campaign briefs by gathering market insights, target audience information, competitive intelligence, and product-related content.
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Product Management, Digital, Launch team, Public Relations, and external agencies to ensure campaign alignment and timely execution.

jobs.occupation: Order picker in day shift - open to English speakers!
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists

• Preparing completed orders for shipment

• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work

• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment

• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you already need to live in Belgium for this job, preferably in the region of Oostkamp or Bruges. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium you do not qualify !!

On behalf of one of our clients, we are looking for a Test Engineer to join a software development team working in Scrum. You will be involved throughout the development lifecycle, from refining user stories to release into production. The role combines functional testing and test automation.

 

Your responsibilities

• Take part in agile ceremonies and in workshops that define acceptance criteria written in Gherkin

• Design test scenarios based on business and technical requirements, prioritising by risk

• Run functional, integration, regression, end-to-end and exploratory tests

• Develop the test automation framework (UI, API, regression) and integrate it into the CI/CD pipeline

• Test REST APIs: contracts, error handling, authentication and data consistency

• Contribute to performance testing when needed

• Log and track defects, and support developers until they are resolved

• Report clear metrics on test progress and release quality

Your profile

• At least 3 years of experience in software testing or QA in an agile environment

• Solid command of BDD (Cucumber or equivalent)

• Hands-on experience with test automation (Selenium or a similar tool) and API testing (Postman/Newman or equivalent)

• Familiarity with Jira (ideally Xray), Git and CI/CD pipelines

• Knowledge of performance testing (JMeter, Gatling...) is a plus

• ISTQB Foundation certification is appreciated

• Analytical mindset, attention to detail and the ability to communicate with both technical and business stakeholders

• Fluent French is mandatory. English is an asset.

What we offer

• Contract: freelance

• Duration: long-term assignment

• Location: Namur, with 2 days of remote work per week

Interested? Send us your CV.

Are you an experienced financial professional with an interest in technology, or an ICT specialist who enjoys working with budgets, forecasts and financial data? For a long-term assignment within a large and complex organisation, we are looking for an ICT Financial Analyst who can combine financial analysis with hands-on operational support.

You will join the ICT Finance team, which manages the end-to-end financial processes of the IT department. This includes budgeting, forecasting, monitoring actual costs, internal invoicing and capacity management.
Your responsibilities

In this role, you will:

• Document the ICT department's budgeting, forecasting and invoicing processes

• Monitor ICT invoices on a daily basis

• Support Service Delivery Managers in preparing their budgets and quarterly forecasts

• Perform financial analyses and translate the results into clear reports

• Prepare quarterly invoices for the different internal clients of the ICT department

• Monitor the capacity of the various ICT teams and assess whether it remains aligned with the available budget

• Calculate and monitor the costs of different infrastructure components

• Combine analytical and documentation work with operational financial tasks 

• You have at least five years of experience in ICT Finance

• You have hands-on experience preparing and managing ICT budgets

• You have experience developing cost models

• You understand financial systems and processes related to budgeting, cost modelling and financial reporting

• You are comfortable analysing financial data and preparing accurate reports

• You have advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables

• Experience with capacity management or FinOps is a strong advantage

• Knowledge of a project management tool such as Jira is an asset

• You are willing to handle both strategic analyses and practical day-to-day financial activities 

Languages and soft skills

• You are fluent in French or Dutch and have at least a passive understanding of the other language

• A good command of English is considered an advantage

• You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• You enjoy working with numbers and have a critical and analytical mindset

• You can work independently while also contributing effectively within a team

• You are well organised and able to meet deadlines

A project on paper is one thing. Making sure it actually works? That’s a whole different story.For an international player in automation and intralogistics, we are looking for a Project Manager to manage complex projects from A to Z.You bring together technology, people, planning and budgets, making sure everything comes together at the right time. From kick-off to final delivery, you keep the overview and step in whenever adjustments are needed.International projects, a lot of responsibility, and technology that you literally see in motion.Functieomschrijving 
• You manage international projects within robotics and industrial automation from A to Z, from kick-off to final delivery. 
• You set up and closely monitor project schedules, budgets and deadlines, making adjustments where needed to ensure successful project delivery. 
• You monitor the project’s quality, scope and risks and proactively anticipate potential changes or challenges throughout the execution. 
• You ensure strong collaboration and transparent communication with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, while leading meetings and project reporting.
 
• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Project Manager, preferably within a technical or industrial environment. 
• You are a strong communicator, hands-on and independent, and you enjoy taking ownership of your projects and results. 
• You are fluent in English; knowledge of French and/or German is a plus. 
• You are willing to travel internationally approximately 20% of the time.

What will you do?  

• Assist our customers with architecture and design of high available, secure and scalable integration solutions. 
• You’ll delve into the creation of an integration reference architecture, integration frameworks and integration strategy. 
• By promoting modularity, scalability and maintainability, you’ll design and develop integration architectures.  
• Cooperate with the customers' project teams to realize sustainable integration solutions.  
• After the implementation phase, you’ll mentor and coach (potential) customers in the Integration methodology and frameworks  
 

Who are we looking for?  

• Experience with one or more middleware technologies and interface technologies and concepts.

• Understand how orchestration and choreography realize business processes and have experience with synchronous and asynchronous integration.  
• Excellent communication skills in Dutch and English  
• Thrives in a hybrid environment, but is also willing to commute to Antwerp, Brussels, or Ghent on a regular basis. 
• Education level minimum Bachelor or equivalent through experience.
